function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period,
       SUM(pl.amount_cad) AS amount_cad,
       SUM(pl.qty) AS qty,
       SUM(pl.amount_cad)/NULLIF(SUM(pl.qty),0) AS avg_cost_per_unit_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE v.vendor_name = 'VEND-SNC'
  AND pl.sku IN ('NUT-ALM','NUT-CAS','NUT-PEC')
  AND pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period
ORDER BY pl.period","purpose":"Vendor VEND-SNC specific SKUs cost and qty"}
